description: Validates, builds, and publishes head. Canonical formatting may create a new head first. Pass the `version` the check returned to refuse publishing a draft that changed since. Takes the edit lease when no `leaseToken` is sent.

leaseToken.description: Omit to have Cactal take the edit lease for you; pass a token from websiteSourceCode.lease.acquire to take over from another editor.

version.description: Version returned by websiteSourceCode.head.check. Publishing refuses when the draft changed after that check.

name: websiteSourceCode_head_publish
title: Publish the head version
